description.value:
The Trollkins stand out as formidable inhabitants of Vana'diel's dense jungles, descendants of true trolls, renowned for their immense strength, thick hides, and regeneration.

Standard Racial Traits

  • Ability Score Modifiers: Trollkin gain +2 Strength, +2 Intelligence, and -4 Charisma.
  • Type: Trollkins are humanoids with the giant subtype.
  • Size: Trollkins are Medium creatures.
  • Speed: Trollkins have a base speed of 30 feet.
  • Languages: Trollkins begin play speaking Common and Giant. Trollkins with high intelligence scores can choose from: Abyssal, Draconic, Dwarven, Elvaan, Infernal, Lalafellen, and Orc.

Defense Racial Traits

  • Fast Healing: Trollkins regain 1 hit point each round (except from starvation, thirst, or suffocation).
  • Fearless: Trollkins receive a +2 racial bonus on saves against fear spells and effects.
  • Thick Skin: Trollkins gain a +1 natural armor bonus.

Feat and Skill Racial Traits

  • Fearsome: Trollkins gain a +2 racial bonus on Intimidate checks.

Offense Racial Traits

  • Bite: Trollkins possess a large toothy maw, a primary natural attack dealing 1d6 points of damage.
  • Claws: Trollkins possess claw-like hands, a primary natural attack dealing 1d4 points of damage.

Senses Racial Traits

  • Darkvision: Trollkins can see perfectly in the dark for up to 60 feet.

Weakness Racial Traits

  • Acid or Fire: When trollkins take fire or earth damage, their fast healing turns off for 1 minute.
